https://luvus.dev/protocol/uhp/v1/event-.$comment: Effective Access permissions are returned by uhp.capabilities on the Access endpoint only; no new event or event-sequence semantics. session.snapshot terminal agent_name is a read projection of operator aliases. agent.name changes aliases without emitting an event or advancing event_sequence. pane.rename updates the same map, emits pane.renamed, and advances event_sequence, including when clearing a name. Consumers refresh snapshots to observe aliases; the sequence is not an alias ETag because agent.name is silent.

agent_status.description: This event can represent identity or metadata changes with unchanged status. Such events cannot complete agent.prompt wait=true. The agent_prompt response and prompt-failure data, not this event payload, carry observed_state for a new working or blocked transition; this is not confirmation that prompt text was consumed.

context.description: Fraction of the model context window already consumed. This is not task-completion progress.

No-wait returns queue admission immediately. wait=true requires a new working or blocked transition before matching until, bounded by timeout_s (default 300). until and timeout_s require wait=true. agent.wait remains a current-state matcher.

agentListTitles.description: Each agent.list row may carry the same bounded session title as the snapshot. Other row fields remain extensible.

agentSessionTitle.description: Live agent session display title: a single line of at most 160 Unicode scalar values, or null when unavailable. Display data only, never an identifier; older servers omit it.

effectiveAccess.description: Access-only endpoint authority. The owner endpoint omits this field; unknown additive fields remain valid. allowed_methods is a subset of methods enforced by the gateway.

observedAgentPromptResult.description: The observed_state field identifies the prompt-wait shape. It records the first new working or blocked transition, or null on timeout before one occurs. submitted means queued, not confirmed delivery. No-wait and legacy responses omit this field.

promptFailureData.description: Coordinates retained when a queued prompt wait loses its pane or terminal. submitted and queued describe queue admission only.

snapshotAliases.description: Operator aliases and bounded live agent session titles are separate fields. Other snapshot fields remain extensible.

text.$comment: Consumers must also enforce a 65536-byte UTF-8 limit and verify bytes and lines against the decoded text.
